primary_book: Ziegler, Biersack and Littmark, The Stopping and Range of Ions in Matter, Vol. 1 (1985)

variants.normalization: 8.462 coefficient and 1e-15 eV cm2/atom unit convention cross-checked with Geant4 source

variants.note: deterministic mean formula only; Geant4 engine and straggling sampler not run

implementation: independent implementation of published mathematical formula; primary Geant4/SIMNRA software not redistributed
BN_mixing: atomic-fraction Bragg additivity; chemical-bond, phase and anisotropy corrections uncalibrated
mass_parameters: explicit approximate atomic masses for stopping model; not event-generator rest-mass constants
